messages:
marta: CI integration red on main — failing 3 tests in hosted integration suite
marta: errors look like a mix of 401 auth failures and a schema validation error on streaming responses
marta: CI log excerpt:
```
ERROR: /tests/integration/hosted_stream_test.py::test_tool_stream
AssertionError: response schema validation failed: missing required property 'tools'
Caused by: upstream 200 stream chunk without tools array
...
ERROR: /tests/integration/auth_test.py::test_token_rotation
HTTP 401 from https://hosted-api.redwood.example.com/v1/respond
headers: {Authorization: "Bearer REDACTED"}
```
marta: repro'd locally with HEAD (abc123..def456) — same failures
marta: re-ran CI pipeline once, still red
ci-bot: CI Summary: 3 failed, 42 passed. Failing jobs: integ-hosted-stream, integ-auth, integ-schema-guard
jason: are we sure it's not an infra flip? envs changed? did anyone rotate the hosted auth key tonight?
priya: not on my watch. no scheduled rotation in PagerDuty notes. I can bisect if someone confirms the commit range
lucas: quick check — local curl against hosted API returns 200 for plain chat, but stream routes drop 'tools' in JSON envelope for chunked responses
lucas: example curl:
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"test","stream":true}' \
  https://hosted-api.redwood.example.com/v1/respond
```
marta: thanks — pointing @priya to bisect on abc123..def456
priya: ack — starting bisect now. will post first guilty commit or zip of logs
jason: if this is an SDK change that altered streaming envelope, we should consider a rollback on the SDK deploy in prod after bisect
marta: also keep an eye on token header normalization — earlier change normalized `authorization` header case which might've caused gateway to drop token
priya: first bisect pass narrowed to commit def234 -> fedcba3, running tests now
ci-bot: queued re-run of integ-hosted-stream on runner-12
lucas: leaving a note: the schema guard lib updated yesterday (v2.4.0) — could be related
marta: action items: priya bisect, jason check SDK deploys last 24h, lucas gather streaming envelope diffs, i'll open an incident if we get a confirmed regression
priya: bisect found failing commit: fedcba3 (changes in http header normalization + schema-guard bump). creating PR to revert and run hotfix CI
marta: perfect. please ping here with the revert PR link
priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821 — reverting header-normalize + schema-guard pin
jason: will prepare a quick canary deploy after CI passes
marta: thanks team :pray:
